_comment: Identity patterns for .tools/sanitize-guard.py — the list that names YOU, so it never goes in the public tree. Copy to agent/local/sanitize-patterns.json (gitignored), or keep it elsewhere and point EDVA_SANITIZE_PATTERNS at it; in CI, store the JSON in the EDVA_SANITIZE_PATTERNS_JSON repo secret. Keys are pattern names and are PUBLIC: accepted hits in .tools/sanitize-guard-baseline.json are keyed by them and every reported hit prints its name. So a name describes the kind of identifier (owner_handle, project_homepage, companion_app_name, address_1, org_1) and never spells the brand, domain, handle, person or place it matches. Values are the private part: Python regexes, matched case-insensitively per line. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
